[![issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/NomNes/hexo-filter-base64.svg)](https://github.com/NomNes/hexo-filter-base64/issues)


Hexo filter that transforms files into base64 URIs

## Installation

```console
$ npm install hexo-filter-base64
```

## Usage

The filter is enabled by default with the configuration:

```yaml
filter_base64:
  enabled: true
  limit: 100000
```

## Options

### `enabled`
Type: `Boolean`
Default: `true`

The filter will only work if true.

### `limit`

Type: `Number` 
Default: `100000`

A `Number` specifying the maximum size of a file in bytes.
If the file is less than or equal to the limit, it will be transformed into a base64 string.
